lines.en: I am rooted here and cannot walk.

lines.zh: 我的藤蔓在地上慢慢伸展
lines.en: My vines spread slowly along the ground.

lines.zh: 叶子跟着我摆动了一下
lines.en: My leaves sway with me.

lines.zh: 我在土里挪了一点根须
lines.en: I shift a root in the soil.
A vine tip reaches out and withdraws.

lines.zh: 我的身体随光转了一点
lines.en: My body turns slightly with the light.

lines.zh: 丛林里有别的叶子在动
lines.en: Other leaves move in the jungle.
I raise myself an inch.
The vines trace an arc on the ground.
I shake the dew off me.

lines.zh: 我把一根藤绕到树根上
lines.en: I wind one vine around a root.

lines.zh: 我的叶子跟着风转了一下
lines.en: My leaves turn with the wind.

lines.zh: 我立着，看起来只是植物
lines.en: I stand, looking like any plant.
A bug crawls up my stem.
Water shines on my leaves.
I wait for something to come near.
My vines are gathered at my base.
The jungle light passes over me.
I slowly open one leaf.
I hold still, very patient.

lines.zh: 我的藤蔓底下有虫子爬
lines.en: Insects crawl beneath my vines.
I turn one leaf to the light.

lines.zh: 丛林里的水汽落在我的叶上
lines.en: Jungle damp settles on my leaves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢收拢最外那根藤
lines.en: I slowly draw in the outermost vine.
There is moss on my stem.
I spread my vines flat on the soil.
My leaf tips droop.
A shaft of light moves onto me.
I lay my vines flat on the ground.
I raise a leaf against the light.
I turn to you, very slightly.
You did not notice that I moved.

lines.zh: 你站在我的藤蔓范围里
lines.en: You stand within my vines' reach.

lines.zh: 我的叶子把你遮住一半
lines.en: My leaves hide half of you.
One more step and you are in.
I am in no hurry; I have waited long.
My vine tip is at your feet.
You are standing on one of my vines.
One of my leaves tilts toward you.

lines.zh: 我不说话，植物本来不说话
lines.en: I do not speak; plants never do.

lines.zh: 你的鞋压在我一根藤上
lines.en: Your shoe presses one of my vines.
I have vines behind you too.
Half a vine is severed.
My leaves curl in.
I shrink a little into the soil.

lines.zh: 我的茎歪了，又慢慢直起
lines.en: My stem tilts, then slowly rises.
Several of my vines are severed.
All my leaves have curled.
My stem leans to one side.
I shrink a stretch into the soil.
I do not move again for a while.

lines.zh: 我缩回到只有菜那么高
lines.en: I shrink back to the height of a vegetable.
What you hold has a smell.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可我喜欢靠近
lines.en: I need not eat, but I like to be near.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我就过来
lines.en: Set it down and I will come.
My vines rise slowly.
I will not snatch; I only want to smell.
You stand too far from me.
My vine touches your hand first.
That smell comes from the soil side.
I roll it under my leaves.

lines.zh: 你不用怕，我不会立刻动
lines.en: Do not fear; I will not move at once.
You walk into my vines.
The vines close, then release.
My leaves brush your face.
I sway, and my roots hold.

lines.zh: 你在我的茎上撞了一下
lines.en: You strike my stem.
You snap one of my thin vines.
My leaves brush your face.
I give you half a foot of room.
We collide and I sway.
My vines tighten around your feet.
Another stands nearby, also moving.
Our vines twine together.
Her leaves open wider than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝有光的地方偏
lines.en: We lean toward the light together.
Our roots touch under the soil.

lines.zh: 她的藤伸过来搭在我的茎上
lines.en: Her vine reaches over onto my stem.
We open our leaves together.

lines.zh: 她的根和我的缠在一处
lines.en: Her roots twine with mine.
We lean toward the same light.
She too has rooted beside me.
I curl a vine tip around it.
I lift it into the air.
It sways on my vine.
I bring it slowly before me.
Not food; I set it down.
I roll it into the middle of my vines.
Held to my eye — I can't see it.
I release the vine and it falls to the soil.
I tap it twice with a vine tip.
My vine rolls it over to my roots.
I spread all my vines.
My leaves turn.
All my leaf tips have turned toward you.
The jungle light falls on me.
The outermost vine moves first.
All my leaves turn to you.
You have stepped inside my ring.
I am in no hurry to draw the vines in.
My roots grip the soil.
Every vine on this ground is mine.
I have left one vine behind you.
You stand amid my shade.
My vines close an inch at a time.
You retreat and the vines draw back a little.
My leaves block your path.

lines.zh: 我的身体一点没挪，藤在动
lines.en: My body has not shifted; the vines are moving.
You cannot hear the vines moving.

lines.zh: 我一根一根地把藤送过去
lines.en: I send my vines out one by one.

lines.zh: 我的叶子挡住了你的退路
lines.en: My leaves close your way back.
I do not move my body, only the vines.
Two steps back, and the vines follow two.
A vine tip circles your foot.
Cut one, and several remain.
I make no sound at all.
One vine lashes out.
A vine tip strikes your arm.

lines.zh: 我另一根从下面缠上来
lines.en: Another vine winds up from below.
You pull, and half a vine snaps.
A vine whips in from the side.
A vine tip winds around your wrist.
I trip your feet from below.

lines.zh: 一根藤断了，另一根接着来
lines.en: One vine snaps; another comes on.
I withdraw quickly after the strike.

lines.zh: 我的叶子打在你眼睛上
lines.en: My leaf slaps across your eyes.
I show myself out of the undergrowth.

lines.zh: 我先动的是最外面那根藤
lines.en: The outermost vine moves first.
My leaves open one by one.

lines.zh: 丛林里多了一株会动的
lines.en: The jungle has gained a moving plant.
I settle my roots in the soil.

lines.zh: 我从土里顶出第一根藤
lines.en: I push my first vine out of the soil.
My leaves unfold one by one.

lines.zh: 丛林里没有风，我却在动
lines.en: There is no wind, yet I move.
My roots spread beneath the soil.

lines.zh: 我把自己撑到与你齐高
lines.en: I raise myself to your height.
The undergrowth is pushed apart.
Mud still clings to my stem.

lines.zh: 火沿着藤烧上来，我缩不回根里
lines.en: Fire climbs the vines and I cannot pull back to my root.

lines.zh: 我从高处折下来，倒在地上
lines.en: I break from above and fall to the ground.

lines.zh: 水泡着我的根，我透不过气
lines.en: Water soaks my roots and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的叶子全打落
lines.en: The blast strips every leaf from me.
Something passes through my leaves.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的藤都僵住
lines.en: That force freezes all my vines.

lines.zh: 土里的养分不够，我的叶发黄
lines.en: The soil lacks nourishment; my leaves yellow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的茎上，我整株都焦了
lines.en: Lightning strikes my stem and scorches me whole.

lines.zh: 土没有了，我的根抓着空
lines.en: The soil is gone and my roots grip nothing.
